subtitle: 버튼 있어서 올입찰했는데 무슨 법 있음?!

cuts.speaker: 노움 도적
cuts.dialogue:
다들 차비 누르는데 냥꾼님
칼이랑 사슬까지 올입찰?!
cuts.visual_prompt: High-angle dungeon loot shot in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal dungeon stone floor touch. On the left, carefree Dwarf Hunter (blunderbuss rifle slung on back) happily tosses a chunky 6-sided white-and-gold loot die with round dot pips only (no digits) while hoarding a compact one-handed sword and silver interlocking ring-mesh mail armor tunic, as her cute round chubby brown baby bear (green scarf) cheers innocently beside her. On the right, Gnome Rogue (bare unadorned blonde twin pigtails, zero hairpins, daggers sheathed) stares wide-eyed in disbelief.

cuts.speaker: 타우렌 드루이드
cuts.dialogue:
끝나고 조용히 귓드려요.
안 쓰는 템은 차비가 국룰이에요
cuts.visual_prompt: Over-the-shoulder two-shot in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal cobblestone touch. On the left, gentle kindhearted Tauren Druid (leafy wooden staff stowed on back) leans softly cupping one empty hand politely with soft glowing pastel whisper sparkles (zero text). On the right, Dwarf Hunter (blunderbuss rifle slung on back) turns around with a sudden prickly scowl while her cute round chubby brown baby bear (green scarf) blinks nervously beside her.

cuts.speaker: 드워프 사냥꾼
cuts.dialogue:
누르는 버튼 있어서 눌렀는데요?!
무슨 법이라도 있음?!
cuts.visual_prompt: Low-angle dramatic outburst shot in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with sharp comic anger lines. On the left, shamelessly furious Dwarf Hunter (blunderbuss rifle slung on back) leans forward jabbing an empty pointing finger defiantly with blazing amber eyes while her cute round chubby brown baby bear (green scarf) puffs its cheeks mimicking her. On the right, gentle Tauren Druid (leafy wooden staff stowed on back) reels backward in stunned shock.

Dutch-tilt extreme big bust-up close-up filling 82 percent of frame height in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with crisp pale shock waves. Centered, gentle Tauren Druid freezes completely dumbfounded with tiny blank dot eyes, open jaw, pale forehead shadow, and giant cold sweat drops in absolute speechless disbelief.

cuts.speaker: 노움 도적
cuts.dialogue:
버튼 있어서 눌렀다고?!
착하게 팁 줬다가 봉변당했네
cuts.visual_prompt: Side-profile comedic two-shot in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal floor shadow. On the left, Gnome Rogue (bare unadorned blonde twin pigtails, zero hairpins, daggers sheathed) slaps her forehead in an exaggerated facepalm with deadpan exasperated eyes. On the right, slumped Tauren Druid (leafy wooden staff stowed on back) clutches the back of her neck looking utterly exhausted.

cuts.speaker: 타우렌 드루이드
cuts.dialogue:
법은 없어도 차단 버튼은
있으니까 지금 바로 눌러줌!
cuts.visual_prompt: Back-view wide comic finale in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal stone road touch. On the left, fed-up Tauren Druid (leafy wooden staff stowed on back) furiously jabs an empty finger in the air with glowing steam puffs around her head. On the right background, smug Dwarf Hunter (blunderbuss rifle slung on back) struts casually away hauling an overflowing brown loot sack while her cute round chubby brown baby bear (green scarf) waddles proudly behind her.
